tool_args.rationale: The observed output is nonlinear in u_now, but the authoritative bridge note specifies a two-layer siphon and the pilot signatures indicate bridge thermal-fin and flux-conservation behavior. The existing five rows vary only u_now at one horizon and fixed state, leaving temporal/open-branch behavior unidentifiable. A targeted open-branch probe is the lowest-cost relevant discriminator.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a smooth snapshot law to the five existing rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All rows share H, u_past, x_now, mem_conv, and s_grad, so they cannot identify the two-layer temporal bridge or distinguish its open-branch behavior.
Its higher cost is unnecessary before a targeted branch-discriminating observation.
It is unrelated to the bridge/flux-conservation evidence and is expressly not useful for identifying the target law.
